title: 636017 Move Cost Accounting report action tooltips to report objects
summary: Report action tooltips for Cost Accounting reports are moved from page actions to report objects themselves, eliminating duplication and ensuring consistent tooltips across all invocations of these reports.
key_points: Tooltips for 16 Cost Accounting reports moved to report objects
Duplicate tooltips removed from page actions in W1 and country layers
Changes propagated across 18 country layer forks
Metadata-only change with no runtime behavior impact
Cleanup continuation following same pattern used for other modules
quote: Moves the report action ToolTips for the Cost Accounting reports off the page actions that run them and onto the report objects themselves
